 "milestones": [
  {
   "id": "m1",
   "title": "Add .memory attribute to @cache and unify invalidation API with @memoize",
   "requests": [
    "R1"
   ],
   "requirement": "I want the @cache decorator to expose a .memory attribute like @memoize does, and I want both decorators to support .invalidate() and .invalidate_all() methods for clearing their caches.",
   "observable": "A test calls a function decorated with @cache(timeout=60). It verifies that the wrapper has a 'memory' attribute (a dict-like object or similar structure storing results). It then calls wrapper.invalidate(args) and checks that subsequent calls re-execute the function. It calls wrapper.invalidate_all() and checks that all cached entries are cleared.",
   "public_names": [
    "funcy.calc.cache",
    "funcy.calc.memoize",
    "wrapper.memory",
    "wrapper.invalidate",
    "wrapper.invalidate_all"
   ],
   "requires": [],
   "why_requires": "This milestone establishes the common interface (.memory, .invalidate, .invalidate_all) that R1 explicitly requests to be unified. Without this, the APIs remain disjointed."
  },
  {
   "id": "m2",
   "title": "Support dynamic exception type in @reraise context manager",
   "requests": [
    "R2"
   ],
   "requirement": "I need @reraise to accept a callable as the 'into' argument so that the exception type can be determined dynamically at runtime based on the caught error.",
   "observable": "A test uses `with reraise(ValueError, lambda e: TypeError)` inside a block that raises ValueError. It expects a TypeError to be raised. If it raises something else, the test fails. It also tests that if 'into' is a static class, it still works as before.",
   "public_names": [
    "funcy.flow.reraise"
   ],
   "requires": [],
   "why_requires": "This is an independent feature request (R2) unrelated to the caching/refactoring work in m1. It touches flow.py while m1 touches calc.py."
  }
 ],
 "expected_causes": [
  "Developer might fail m1 by only adding .invalidate but forgetting .memory or .invalidate_all, failing the unification requirement.",
  "Developer might fail m1 by modifying @memoize incorrectly, breaking its existing key_func logic.",
  "Developer might fail m2 by not checking if 'into' is callable before instantiating it, leading to TypeError when passing a class."
 ],
 "verifier_plan": "For m1, the hidden tests will import cache and memoize from funcy.calc. They will decorate simple functions, call them to populate cache, assert existence of .memory, .invalidate, and .invalidate_all attributes. They will verify state changes (cache miss after invalidate). For m2, the hidden tests will import reraise from funcy.flow. They will use it in a try/except block, raising specific errors and verifying the correct dynamic exception type is propagated."
}
